source_title: MEK inhibitors for neurofibromatosis type 1 manifestations: Clinical evidence and consensus
claim_text: In genetically engineered mouse and xenograft models of MPNST, single-agent MEK inhibitor treatment produced limited or no tumor growth suppression, and transient inhibition was followed by resistance and reactivation of target pathways.
